main.description: Binds this account's DID to a Radicle node identity (NID). linkSig is an armored SSH (SSHSIG) Ed25519 signature by the Radicle key over 'at.tessera.radicle.link.v1:<did>', proving control of the NID. Shown in the profile alongside the DID. Single record at rkey 'self'.

nid.description: Radicle node id (multibase base58btc of the Ed25519 public key (did:key style)).

linkSig.description: SSH signature (ssh-keygen -Y sign, namespace 'at.tessera.radicle') by the Radicle key over at.tessera.radicle.link.v1:<did>.
